orgSettings.title: Organization settings
orgSettings.not_found: Organization not found, or you have no access to it.
orgSettings.desc_general: Name, color and logo the organization's users see.
orgSettings.desc_modules: Which pages the organization's users find in the menu.
orgSettings.modules_card: Untick the pages this organization does not use: they disappear from its users' menu.
orgSettings.desc_security: Sign-in rules that apply to every user of the organization.
orgSettings.desc_sso: Sign in with a Google Workspace or Microsoft company account.
orgSettings.desc_invites: A one-time invite link to let a new person in.
orgSettings.desc_apikeys: Keys edge boxes and external systems use to call this organization's API.
orgSettings.desc_edge: Who polls the PLCs, box status, and installing a new one.
orgSettings.desc_mqtt: Read-only broker credentials for SCADA, Node-RED, MES.
orgSettings.desc_webhooks: HTTP calls to your systems when something happens.
orgSettings.identity_desc: The name shows in the menu and in reports; the color replaces the interface yellow for the organization's users.
